items.zh: 领导，下个月我想请五天年假，方便吗？
items.scene: 提前一个月向部门主管请年假

answers.en: I'd like to take five days off next month — would that work?
answers.note: 先讲打算再问是否可行，客气但直接，适合提前一个月正式请假。

answers.en: Would it be okay if I took five days of PTO next month?
answers.note: PTO 是美式职场说法，整句更委婉，适合公司流程正式、要留邮件记录时。

answers.en: Any chance I could take next month off for five days?
answers.note: Any chance 带试探意味，像随口问问，适合和关系熟的主管口头沟通。

items.zh: 你今年年假还剩几天？我想凑个长周末出去。
items.scene: 午饭时问旁边的同事还剩几天年假

answers.en: How many vacation days do you have left this year?
answers.note: 标准问法，直接用 vacation days，适合不熟或需要说清楚的场合。

answers.en: How much PTO do you have left?
answers.note: PTO 更职场化，省略 this year，适合熟同事之间快速一问。

answers.en: You got any vacation days left this year?
answers.note: 省略 Do，很口语，适合边吃饭边随口聊，正式邮件里别用。

items.zh: 十一想出去玩，你有没有什么推荐的地方？
items.scene: 微信上问刚旅行回来的朋友

answers.en: I'm thinking of going somewhere over National Day — any recommendations?
answers.note: 先说自己有计划再求推荐，语气自然，适合朋友之间不显得突兀。

answers.en: Got any suggestions for where to go over the break?
answers.note: 省略主语，把假期说成 the break，很随口，适合微信语音或闲聊。

answers.en: Where would you go if you had a week off in October?
answers.note: 用假设句请对方代入，不直接要推荐，适合对方刚玩回来、想听真实想法时。

items.zh: 成都和重庆，带爸妈去哪个更合适？
items.scene: 和伴侣商量带父母出游的目的地

answers.en: Chengdu or Chongqing — which one is better for a trip with my parents?
answers.note: 直接摆出两个选项比较，重点在带父母的旅行，适合和伴侣快速定方向。

answers.en: If we're taking my parents, would you pick Chengdu or Chongqing?
answers.note: 用 If 把前提放前面，语气商量，适合对方也有发言权、不想自己拍板时。

answers.en: Which works better for my parents, Chengdu or Chongqing?
answers.note: 把父母的需求放在前面，重点明确，适合讨论中把话题拉回老人方不方便。

items.zh: 你上次去日本那趟，攻略还在吗？发我一份呗。
items.scene: 微信找朋友要上次日本的行程

answers.en: Do you still have your itinerary from your Japan trip? Could you send it to me?
answers.note: 两句话，先确认还在不在再开口要，礼貌清楚，适合关系一般的朋友。

answers.en: Send me that Japan itinerary of yours, would you?
answers.note: 祈使句加 would you，熟人间很自然，带点理所当然的随意。

answers.en: I remember you planned that Japan trip — any chance you could share what you had?
answers.note: 先给对方一个台阶再请求，最委婉，适合对方行程要花时间整理时。

items.zh: 第一次去云南，七天怎么安排比较合理？
items.scene: 在旅行群里问去过大理的人

answers.en: It's my first time in Yunnan — how would you plan seven days there?
answers.note: 先交代第一次去，再请对方给方案，语气中性，适合群里公开问。

answers.en: What's a good way to split seven days for a first trip to Yunnan?
answers.note: split 强调把七天分开安排，问的是结构，适合想听具体分配的人。

answers.en: First time in Yunnan, seven days — where would you start?
answers.note: 两个短语加一个问题，很口语，重点只问起点，适合轻松聊天。

items.zh: 下周三飞广州的机票，现在买还是再等等？
items.scene: 和常出差的同事聊订票时机

answers.en: Should I book the flight to Guangzhou for next Wednesday now, or wait a bit?
answers.note: 把两个选择摆出来问，语气中性，适合向有经验的人求建议。

answers.en: Is it worth waiting on the Guangzhou flight next Wednesday, or should I just book it?
answers.note: worth waiting 在算值不值得等，带权衡意味，适合票价正在波动时。

answers.en: Think the price will drop if I hold off on Wednesday's flight to Guangzhou?
answers.note: 省略 Do you，直接问对方判断，很随口，适合熟人之间聊。

items.zh: 这个机票能改签吗？我想晚一天走。
items.scene: 打电话给航空公司客服改签

answers.en: Can I change this ticket? I'd like to leave a day later.
answers.note: 先问能不能改，再说需求，简单直接，适合一接通电话就说明来意。

answers.en: Is this ticket changeable? I need to push my departure back by a day.
answers.note: changeable 和 push back 偏书面，适合需要对方按条款答复的客服沟通。

answers.en: Any way I can move this flight to the next day?
answers.note: Any way 带商量口气，move 比 change 更口语，适合态度放软、想争取通融时。

items.zh: 这家酒店离地铁站远不远？拖着箱子方便吗？
items.scene: 订房前问预订平台的在线客服

answers.en: Is this hotel far from the subway? Is it easy to get there with luggage?
answers.note: 两个短问句，先问距离再问行李，清楚直接，适合在线客服快速回复。

answers.en: How close is the hotel to the subway? We'll have suitcases.
answers.note: 问 close 而不是 far，语气更积极；补一句有箱子，让对方主动说路况。

answers.en: Would dragging suitcases from the subway to this hotel be a hassle?
answers.note: dragging 和 hassle 很有画面，偏口语，适合想听真实吐槽而非官方答复。

items.zh: 我们半夜才到，酒店能保留房间吗？
items.scene: 出发前打电话给酒店前台

answers.en: We won't get in until midnight — can you hold our room?
answers.note: 先说到达时间再提要求，语气平和，适合常规的晚到沟通。

answers.en: Our flight lands after midnight. Will the room still be held for us?
answers.note: 用被动问政策，偏正式，适合需要确认酒店正式规定时。

answers.en: We're arriving really late. You guys won't give away our room, right?
answers.note: 带担心和确认意味，很口语，适合和前台半开玩笑地确认。

items.zh: 这趟去新疆，一个人预算大概要多少？
items.scene: 在办公室问刚去过新疆的同事

answers.en: How much should I budget for a trip to Xinjiang per person?
answers.note: 直接问该准备多少预算，中性，适合对方愿意给个范围时。

answers.en: What's a reasonable budget for one person going to Xinjiang?
answers.note: reasonable 让问题变软，像征求意见，适合不想显得只关心钱。

answers.en: Roughly how much did you spend in Xinjiang?
answers.note: 问对方实际花了多少，更具体可信，适合熟人之间直接取经。

items.zh: 咱们这趟人均三千够不够？
items.scene: 出发前在朋友群里对预算

answers.en: Is three thousand per person enough for this trip?
answers.note: 直接问够不够，语气中性，适合群里把数字摆出来对账。

answers.en: Do you think we can keep it to three thousand each?
answers.note: keep it to 强调控制在三千以内，带预算上限的意味。

answers.en: Three grand a head — is that going to cover it?
answers.note: grand、a head 都是口语说法，很随意，适合关系近的朋友群。

items.zh: 下个月去青海，你要不要一起？
items.scene: 微信问关系好的大学同学

answers.en: I'm going to Qinghai next month — want to come along?
answers.note: 先说自己计划再发出邀请，轻松自然，适合好朋友之间。

answers.en: Would you like to join me on a trip to Qinghai next month?
answers.note: Would you like to 更客气，适合关系没那么近或对方比较忙时。

answers.en: Thinking of Qinghai next month. You in?
answers.note: 极简口语，You in 是熟人间的直接邀约，适合微信打字。

items.zh: 这次就我们俩去，还是再叫上几个人？
items.scene: 和闺蜜商量这次旅行的人数

answers.en: Is it just the two of us, or should we invite a few more people?
answers.note: 把两种安排并列问，中性清楚，适合先确认人数再订房。

answers.en: Just us two, or do you want to ask around for more?
answers.note: ask around 是随口问一圈，语气轻松，适合闺蜜之间不设防地聊。

answers.en: Should we keep it to the two of us or make it a group trip?
answers.note: keep it to 和 group trip 对比，偏理性，适合认真权衡费用和自由度。

items.zh: 办日本签证要提前多久预约啊？
items.scene: 问刚办过日本签证的同事

answers.en: How far in advance do I need to book an appointment for a Japan visa?
answers.note: 问需要提前多久，标准清楚，适合第一次办、想按流程走的人。

answers.en: How early should I book my visa appointment for Japan?
answers.note: How early 更口语，意思相同但语气轻，适合随口问同事。

answers.en: Do I need to book the Japan visa appointment way ahead?
answers.note: way ahead 强调提前很多，带确认意味，适合担心来不及的人。

items.zh: 签证材料还要准备银行流水吗？
items.scene: 在签证中心窗口确认材料

answers.en: Do I still need bank statements for the visa?
answers.note: still 暗示之前听说过要，直接确认，适合窗口快速问。

answers.en: Is a bank statement still required as part of the application?
answers.note: 被动加 required，很正式，适合邮件或书面确认材料清单。

answers.en: They still want bank statements, right?
answers.note: 用 They 指签证方，句尾 right 求确认，很口语，适合和同行人核对。

items.zh: 出去玩一周，旅游保险有必要买吗？
items.scene: 出发前和家人讨论买不买保险

answers.en: Is travel insurance worth it for a one-week trip?
answers.note: worth it 在问值不值，中性，适合还没决定、想听意见时。

answers.en: Do we really need travel insurance for just a week?
answers.note: really 和 just 带怀疑，觉得一周没必要，适合想省这笔钱时。

answers.en: Should we get travel insurance for the week?
answers.note: Should we 是提议口气，没预设答案，适合和家人一起做决定。

items.zh: 这个保险保不保航班延误？
items.scene: 在保险页面问在线客服

answers.en: Does this insurance cover flight delays?
answers.note: 最直接的问法，cover 是保险术语，适合在线客服快速答复。

answers.en: Is flight delay covered under this plan?
answers.note: 被动加 under this plan，偏正式，适合要对照条款确认。

answers.en: If my flight gets delayed, does this plan pay out?
answers.note: 用具体情境问赔不赔，pay out 很口语，适合担心实际理赔的人。

items.zh: 去哈尔滨玩，几月份去最合适？
items.scene: 问在东北读过书的朋友

answers.en: What's the best month to visit Harbin?
answers.note: 直接问最佳月份，简洁，适合对方只需给一个答案时。

answers.en: When's the best time of year to go to Harbin?
answers.note: time of year 比 month 宽，允许对方按季节回答，语气更自然。

answers.en: If I want to see Harbin at its best, when should I go?
answers.note: 把目的说清楚再问时间，适合你想看冰雪或避开人潮等具体期待。

items.zh: 现在去三亚会不会太热了？
items.scene: 和同事聊现在去三亚会不会太热

answers.en: Isn't it too hot in Sanya right now?
answers.note: 否定疑问句，带自己已有判断，适合想找人印证时。

answers.en: Is it too hot to go to Sanya this time of year?
answers.note: 中性问法，把热和出行挂钩，适合还没拿定主意。

answers.en: Would Sanya be unbearable this time of year?
answers.note: unbearable 语气最重，夸张口语，适合和熟人吐槽天气。

items.zh: 年假批下来之前，我先订机票会不会有风险？
items.scene: 和同部门朋友商量批假前订票

answers.en: Is it risky to book flights before my leave gets approved?
answers.note: 直接问有没有风险，理性，适合和同部门朋友商量。

answers.en: Should I wait until my time off is approved before booking?
answers.note: Should I 求建议，重点在先后顺序，适合自己拿不定主意时。

answers.en: If my leave falls through, I'm stuck with the ticket, right?
answers.note: fall through 和 stuck 很口语，带担忧，适合熟人之间算最坏情况。

items.zh: 你更想去海边躺着，还是去山里徒步？
items.scene: 和对象商量年假去哪儿

answers.en: Would you rather chill at the beach or go hiking in the mountains?
answers.note: Would you rather 二选一，chill 很口语，适合情侣轻松聊。

answers.en: Do you prefer a beach trip or a hiking trip?
answers.note: prefer 中性偏正式，适合认真比较两种旅行方式。

answers.en: Beach and do nothing, or mountains and hike — which sounds better?
answers.note: 两个短句并列，带画面和玩笑感，适合熟人之间活跃气氛。

items.zh: 网上那些攻略靠谱吗？还是直接问当地人？
items.scene: 做攻略时和同行朋友讨论

answers.en: Are those travel blogs actually reliable, or should we just ask locals?
answers.note: actually 带怀疑，blogs 指网上攻略，适合和朋友讨论信息来源。

answers.en: Do you trust those online guides, or is asking locals better?
answers.note: trust 把问题变成信不信，语气平和，适合征求对方看法。

answers.en: Should we even bother with the online guides? Locals might know better.
answers.note: even bother 带否定倾向，觉得攻略没必要，适合你更信当地人时。

items.zh: 住景区里面贵一点，还是住市区划算？
items.scene: 和同行朋友比较住宿方案

answers.en: Is it worth paying more to stay inside the scenic area, or is downtown better value?
answers.note: worth 和 better value 在算性价比，中性，适合两人认真比较。

answers.en: Should we splurge on a place in the park or save money staying in town?
answers.note: splurge 和 save 对比鲜明，偏口语，适合预算有限又想住得近。

answers.en: Which makes more sense — paying extra to stay in the park, or staying downtown?
answers.note: makes more sense 偏理性，适合把决定摊开分析。

items.zh: 机票现在两千三，要不要再蹲蹲特价？
items.scene: 和室友商量要不要等机票降价

answers.en: The flight's 2,300 right now — should we hold out for a deal?
answers.note: hold out for a deal 是等特价，口语，适合和室友一起盯票价。

answers.en: Should we wait for the price to drop, or just grab it at 2,300?
answers.note: 两个选择并列，grab it 很口语，适合快速做决定。

answers.en: Is 2,300 a good price, or should we keep watching it?
answers.note: 先问价格好不好再问要不要继续看，适合自己没概念时。
